arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Single Exponential Smoothing with alpha = 0.4
# Data: matured noninterest-bearing debt (in millions) for fiscal years 1960-1967

data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Initialize S_1960 = X_1960
years = sorted(data.keys())
S = {}
S[years[0]] = data[years[0]]

print(f"Initialization: S_{years[0]} = {S[years[0]]}")

# Calculate smoothed values for each year
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    year = years[i]
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    S[year] = alpha * data[year] + (1 - alpha) * S[prev_year]
    print(f"S_{year} = {alpha} * {data[year]} + {1-alpha} * {S[prev_year]:.4f} = {alpha * data[year]:.4f} + {(1-alpha) * S[prev_year]:.4f} = {S[year]:.4f}")

# The forecast for 1968 is S_1967 (the smoothed value for the last observation year)
forecast_1968 = S[years[-1]]
print(f"\nForecast for fiscal year 1968: {forecast_1968:.2f} million dollars")
EOF
